rule: If the mouth is open, shade the bottom of the opening to create a sense of depth.
Several levels of tone plus a highlight make a round eye/lens read three-dimensional.
In a manga profile the eye is a short wedge open toward the front, set back from the profile line, about as wide as it is tall, with the iris a narrow upright oval at its front.
Ears placed near the middle of the head (front to back) make the head read human.
